Message:
KVM: emulate_instruction() calls now x86_decode_insn() and x86_emulate_insn()

emulate_instruction() calls now x86_decode_insn() and x86_emulate_insn().
x86_emulate_insn() is x86_emulate_memop() without the decoding part.
